## Overview

LRP258 is the **ability-adjusted** counterpart of [LRP58](../lrp-rli-mech-058/), the
mechanism family's headline curve. It adds `blocks` (WPPSI Block Design) to the matched
conditioning set and changes nothing else — same exposure, outcome, own baseline, HSGP
basis and sampler settings — so the two fitted curves differ only by the ability term.

It exists because the family's negative-control panel showed part of every letter-sound
slope is non-specific, with shared general ability the leading candidate. [LRP201](../lrp-rli-mech-201/)
tests that on the *linear* anchor; this model tests it on the *shape*, which is what the
published figure shows.

`blocks` is a single noisy subtest, not the latent ability node, so `f_mech` stays an
**adjusted association** and the comparison bounds only what the measured proxy accounts
for.

## Model

$$
\eta = \alpha + \alpha_{\text{phase}} + \beta_G G
  + f^L(\operatorname{logit}_* L_{\text{post}})
  + \gamma_{\text{own}}\operatorname{logit}_*(W_{\text{pre}})
  + \gamma_A z(A) + \gamma_{\text{blocks}} z(\text{blocks})
  + \sum_c \gamma_c z(c) + u_{\text{child}}.
$$
